scope: Actual Linux x86_64 source compile/link and libmpv PCM output. This is not a packaged application or release approval.

source.note: The Meson target-order fix in prepare_portable_mpv.py was applied after this checkpoint; exact inputs and prepared patch are recorded below.
source.patch:
--- a/meson.build
+++ b/meson.build
@@ -63,6 +63,7 @@
     'audio/decode/ad_dsd.c',
     'audio/decode/ad_lavc.c',
     'audio/decode/ad_spdif.c',
+    'audio/filter/af_crisper.c',
     'audio/filter/af_drop.c',
     'audio/filter/af_format.c',
     'audio/filter/af_lavcac3enc.c',
@@ -1814,6 +1815,8 @@
 features += {'libmpv-' + get_option('default_library'): get_option('libmpv')}
 
 
+subdir('crisper-dsp')
+
 # build targets
 if win32
     windows = import('windows')
--- a/filters/user_filters.c
+++ b/filters/user_filters.c
@@ -35,6 +35,7 @@
     &af_lavfi_bridge,
     &af_scaletempo,
     &af_scaletempo2,
+    &af_crisper,
     &af_lavfi_tempo,
     &af_format,
 #if HAVE_RUBBERBAND
--- a/filters/user_filters.h
+++ b/filters/user_filters.h
@@ -22,6 +22,7 @@
 extern const struct mp_user_filter_entry af_lavfi_bridge;
 extern const struct mp_user_filter_entry af_scaletempo;
 extern const struct mp_user_filter_entry af_scaletempo2;

command_notes: FFmpeg compiled and installed using the recorded recipe.
Remaining recorded Meson commands were resumed after workspace-only dependency metadata and include-path relocation fixes.
mpv was re-extracted from its hash-verified archive, prepared again with the corrected target insertion point, then configured, compiled and installed.
libplacebo requires Vulkan headers even for disabled-Vulkan stubs; Linux and Windows CI prerequisites now include them. Vulkan rendering remains disabled.
